prose: Bloomberg reports, citing sources, that Nvidia requires Southeast Asian customers seeking Nvidia Cloud Partner status to enroll in a program that tracks the locations of their AI chips, stepping up monitoring of accelerators sold in the region.
highlights: Cloud Partner applicants in Southeast Asia must join chip location tracking
